description: Wildfire History is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Approximate geographic extent of wildfire history within the Brisbane City Council local government area. This data was collated from historical documents in 2016 and can only be used as an approximation of wildfire history up to that point in time. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are burn, bushfire, environment, fire, hazard reduction burns. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2026-02-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
